summary:
flvdemux assertion failures on truncated enhanced (E-RTMP) audio/video tags.
The vulnerable parsing came with enhanced/multitrack FLV support
(af336ac6 "flvdemux: add support for multiple audio and video tracks",
Oct 2025, then enhanced h265/av1), which first shipped in 1.28; the fix
(8aed48f0, 1.28.2) only touches that code. Our 1.26.2 flvdemux is the
legacy parser: no tag_header_len, no enhanced/multitrack tags and none of
the g_assert() calls the fix replaces, and the 1.26 branch never got them.
Debian marks trixie vulnerable only because the fixed version is 1.28.2-1.
